capabilities: run Ironsworn, Starforged, and homebrew campaigns with built-in rulesets
make moves and roll dice through commands and interactive blocks
browse moves, oracles, and character sheets in a sidebar
track multiple campaigns and play multiplayer, online or locally
import custom assets, oracles, and rulesets in Datasworn format
extras: Full documentation lives on a separate documentation site, not in the README. A developer API is listed as coming soon. The plugin can also be installed via BRAT or manually from GitHub releases.
motivation: The author started from Eric Bright's Forged_in_Obsidian template vault and gradually replaced its functionality with this plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run these tabletop RPGs: game rules, oracle rolls, character sheets, and campaign tracking all have to be managed by hand.

relations.evidence: This owes a lot to Eric Bright's Forged_in_Obsidian template vault.
using the data in datasworn format

summary: Tabletop RPG engine for playing Ironsworn and Starforged games in Obsidian, with moves, oracles, progress tracks, and multiplayer.
